Container.Name: geet
Container.Overview:
A small, self-hosted kanban issue tracker for one person.
Tickets nest three levels deep (epic > task > sub-task). Boards are saved filters over a single pool of tickets, so the same ticket can appear on an epics board and a team board without being duplicated. Sub-tasks render inside their parent's card while they share its status, and break out onto their own card when they don't.
Single Go binary with the web UI compiled in. Data is one SQLite file in /data. No account, no cloud, no external services.
Container.Description: A small, self-hosted kanban issue tracker for one person. Epics, tasks and sub-tasks, boards as saved filters, markdown descriptions and comments. One binary, one SQLite file.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds geet.db, the entire database. Back this up.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the database file. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the database file. Unraid default is 100 (users).
